Styleguide.title: Styleguide
Styleguide.intro: Shared building blocks for every page. All data on this page is sample data.
Styleguide.colorsHint: Every text/background pair is checked against WCAG AA contrast in a test.
Styleguide.bodySample: Nguyễn Văn Ánh checks the total and the VAT of the invoice.
Styleguide.fieldSellerHint: Exactly as printed on the invoice.
Styleguide.fieldTaxCodeError: Invalid tax code: wrong check digit.
Styleguide.fieldTotalWarning: Low confidence, compare with the source document.
Styleguide.emptyHint: Upload your first invoice to get started.
Styleguide.errorHint: Check your connection and try again.
Styleguide.a11y1: Text meets 4.5:1 contrast; borders and focus rings meet 3:1.
Styleguide.a11y2: Every input has a label tied by htmlFor.
Styleguide.a11y3: Keyboard: Tab reaches every control and the focus ring is always visible.
Styleguide.a11y4: Status always has a word and an icon, never colour alone.
Styleguide.a11y5: Errors use role=alert; loading uses role=status.

Shell.forbiddenHint: Your account is not allowed to act for the selected tenant. Switch tenant or ask an administrator.
Shell.unavailableHint: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
Shell.forbiddenRequired: Your account belongs to several tenants and none is selected yet. Pick one in the header; if there is no list, sign out and sign in again.
Shell.forbiddenNotMember: The selected tenant is not one of your tenants. Pick another one in the header, or sign out and in again if your access changed.
